name: With rugs: as A, Andrew's UPLIFT pair and IKEA storage, with the LOHALS flatweave under the chair mats
notes:
With rugs (F-66), re-staged 2026-11-16 with a, piece for piece, plus the LOHALS flatwoven rug (ikea-30511288, 52 x 77") in the aisle under both bamboo chair mats, x 27-79, y 20-97, 3" under each desk's front edge; the rug-free room is a. Until then f was the MITTZON room, now i, with its rugs.
Staged since 2026-11-16, promoted from i when Andrew ordered the office's IKEA storage ("all in office, some in the wardrobe has about 38" depth") and, the same day, the two UPLIFT desks; the MITTZON run staged until then is i. His UPLIFT cart (2026-11-08, three screenshots: "will 2 of the bamboo desks fit in office? the essential standing desk ($399) is going in a spare room, probably bedroom, but not decided yet."): the two V3 Standing Desks in Bamboo 1", 80 x 30" and 60 x 30", in a's arrangement (the personal run on the right wall, the job desk on the left at the window end, the chair bed below it). Both fit, one way only: facing each other on the two side walls, 46" apart. Each side wall holds 104" between the heater line (y 12: the hatched wall counts whole, F-33, heater-depth-assumed) and the wardrobe's landing (y 116, F-31, assumed-position:closet). The window wall takes no desk (F-62) and the bottom wall is the wardrobe and the door (F-31). As an L they don't fit: the 60" return off the 80" ends 16" from the opposite wall, where the way in from the door runs (F-30), and the 80" across the room would need 110" of the 106". The mirror image (the 80" on the left wall, the 60" and the chair bed on the right) works the same.
desk-1 UPLIFT V3 80 x 30 bamboo (other-UPL960-bamboo-80x30), right wall, rot 90, x 76-106, y 36-116: the personal run. F-62 as revised 2026-11-16 (Andrew: "yea i have 4 monitors, so 3 and 1"): three 32" screens on their own stands, the outer two angled in about 30 degrees, about 76.5" of the 80" (84" flat); no monitor arms (Andrew, 2026-11-16: none for now). The cables drop through the desk's two grommets, so the desk stands flush to the wall. F-31: its south end on the wardrobe landing's line (it shares x 76-78 of it) and 6" above the door's landing (assumed-position:door). F-35: 46" in front of it to the job desk (y 36-72) and 42.9" to the chair bed (y 73-104.5), so the way past its chair keeps the 42" for passing · fits.
desk-2 UPLIFT V3 60 x 30 bamboo (other-UPL960-bamboo-60x30), left wall, rot 270, x 0-30, y 12-72: the job station, the laptop on the ELLOVEN beside one 32" monitor, 46.5" of its 60", 13.5" to spare (F-62). F-33: 6" from the heater's drawn face. F-35: 46" in front of it to the run, 76" at its window end · fits.
chair-1 FLINTAN at the run, x 46-74, y 62-90, facing it; chair-2 FLINTAN at the job desk, x 32-60, y 21-49, 15" from the heater's face (F-33's 12" for upholstery); 13" apart, so both stations work at once · fits.
chairbed-1 IKEA PS 2026 chair bed (F-62's small daybed), left wall below the job desk, x 0-33.1, y 73-104.5: 1" below desk-2, 11.5" above the wardrobe's landing. Opened, it reaches x 79.9, its last 3.9" under desk-1. The V3 frame's width adjusts from 41.3" to 72.2" and its feet run 27.6" deep (Specs), so set 63" or wider under the 80" top, the feet stand outside the bed's 31.5" (y 73-104.5): check that when assembling, and hang the bamboo drawer and the FlexMount pouch at the run's window end, so nothing hangs over the bed's band. desk-1 stays raised and unplugged while a guest sleeps, as in a · fits.
His IKEA storage, ordered 2026-11-16 (the 26 3/8" ALEX came out of the cart): storage-3, one ALEX 14 1/8x29 7/8 on casters, at the run's window end against the right wall, x 83.1-106, y 21.9-36, flush with the desk's end; F-33: 15.9" from the heater's drawn face; F-32: 23 1/8" to the job chair's back corner (tight:23.1, 24" with the chair in 7/8"); anchored to the right wall (F-21). storage-4, one HELMER, on the left wall between the chair bed and the wardrobe's landing, x 0-17.4, y 104.75-115.75, 1/4" from each; F-32: 24" clear in front; F-31: off the landing (assumed-position:closet); it is the guest's nightstand when the bed is open. Under the desks (extras, not drawn: the planner draws one piece per patch of floor): the two ALEX 14 1/8x19 5/8 sets under the 80", one each side of the chair against the wall (y 47.5-61.6 and 90.4-104.5); at 19 5/8" they stay under at every height (the desk's underside never goes below 24.1"); with the frame at 63" or wider, as the chair bed already needs, each fits between a leg and the chair's 28": check when assembling; the south one stands behind the open bed's foot (x 79.9). The other HELMER under the job desk's south end (y 49 to 72, before its leg): at 25 5/8" it stays under while the desk's top is above about 27" (its lowest is 25.1"); the V3 reverses if lowered onto it. In the wardrobe (about 38" deep, Andrew, 2026-11-16, not the sketch's 22"; 68" wide): one KALLAX upright against its back wall (43 7/8 x 15 3/8"), anchored to it (F-21), and the other tall ALEX beside it, 58" of the 68"; a HELMER would need 11" of the 10" left. The KALLAX is 57 5/8" tall: below any shelf or rod (the inside height is not measured). Not placed: the second KALLAX (43 7/8 x 15 3/8 x 57 5/8"). No wall is left: the right wall is the run and its window end (the ALEX), the left wall the job desk, the chair bed and the HELMER, the window wall a heater wall (F-33, F-38), and the bottom wall the wardrobe and the door with their landings (F-31); two KALLAXes need 87 3/4" of the wardrobe's 68". It would stand on the left wall in the chair bed's place, between the job desk (y 72) and the wardrobe's landing (y 116): 44" for its 43 7/8".
storage-2 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4" (top): hung above the job desk, centered (y 18.4-65.6), underside about 75" up: the UPLIFT on its Soft Roll Casters rises to 51.2", so the job monitor needs it; its top about 90". The ceiling is unmeasured (F-63, F-23).
lamp-1 TÅGARP and plant-1 FEJKA: the bottom-left corner, left of the wardrobe's landing, as in a. lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top) on the job desk's window end; lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top) on the run's window-end front corner, in front of the angled end screen. art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): one canvas centered over the chair bed (y 77.75-99.75); a row of three would run over the job desk's south end, in its rising path, so the other two hang one above the other over the plant.
rug-2 and rug-3, two Anji Mountain bamboo chair mats 48 x 36" (rug; wipeable and plastic-free, F-66): one across the aisle under chair-2 (x 29-77, y 17-53, 1" under each desk's front edge, clear of desk-2's feet), one along it under chair-1 (x 40-76, y 54-102), since the aisle beside the chair bed is 42.9" and a's 60 x 48 would run under the bed's front.
The way in from the door: from its landing west across the wardrobe's, then up the aisle: 44.4" diagonally between the bed's corner and the run's south end, 42.9" beside the bed, 46" between the desks (F-30), with chair-1 tucked in; pulled out, it leaves 12.9" beside the bed, as a's run chair does.
Rugless, as a (F-66). Kid safety (F-21): the job desk stands by the window and its chair rolls, so Maddie could climb to the window: fit window stops there (the sill is unmeasured, F-38). Both desks roll on casters: lock them once placed, so a push doesn't move a desk with its screens. The tall ALEX and the wardrobe's KALLAX are anchored (F-21); the drawer units' casters lock too.
UPLIFT's free accessories in the cart (with each desk a Rocker-X board, a standing desk mat, a bamboo desk drawer and a clamp-on cup holder; a tumbler and a mug with the 80") are not in the catalog and not drawn: the drawer and the cup holder mount on the desks, and the standing mat's material is unread, so it stays out of this rugless room until it is (F-66). Each V3 includes a FlexMount Cable Manager, so this layout has no FÖRSÄSONG trays. No outlets are mapped: two motors, four screens, the job laptop and the lamps need a power strip in each FlexMount, with a slack loop for the desk's 26.1" of travel.
Not placed: Eutine's desk from the same cart, a UPLIFT V3 48 x 30" in Maple laminate on a white frame ($688; it replaced the V3 Essential 46 x 24" on 2026-11-16, Andrew: "I switched out wife's desk for a cusstom one, she wants that one"), for a room not chosen yet.
Total $4,241.78: placed $3,551.89 + extras $689.89, prices as in a (the LOHALS as of 2026-10-22, price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: anchor-required, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door, heater-depth-assumed, tight:23.1.
2026-11-17: both KALLAXes on the Dec 1 truck go on the inset wall that runs along the living room and the dining room (Andrew), so the wardrobe takes no KALLAX: the tall ALEX stands there alone, and nothing here waits for a second one.
